description: This file contains server-side logic for the Leaderboard page of an online examination system. It manages user session validation, retrieves user information from a database, and handles navigation to other pages such as Dashboard, User Profile, and Login.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard ASP.NET page, handling page load events and button clicks for navigation and session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles logic when the page loads, including session validation and database query to retrieve the user's semester.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for Leaderboard button; currently empty.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting the session and navigating to the login page.
